dataset.method: Stortingets vedtak om CO2-avgift på mineralske produkter (under særavgiftsloven): the CO2-avgift on mineral oil, generell sats, kr 3.17 per litre from 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31, as the Ministry of Finance's tables and press release give it. The importer or producer pays it and passes it on in the pump price, so a trip pays it where its fuel is bought. Litres are the trip's road fuel as given (diesel_l), or its tank-to-wheel CO2 at 2.67 kg per litre of diesel (EN 16258:2012).

sources.title: Finansdepartementet: Avgiftssatser 2025 (the 2024 rules and the 2025 budget agreement), incl. the CO2-avgift on mineral oil per litre (the Internet Archive's copy; regjeringen.no refuses the workflow)
